department: Department of Computer Science; Institute for Bioinformatics and Medical Informatics (IBMI)

deadline.value: The IBMI page gives no deadline; it advises applying before or immediately after starting doctoral studies.
deadline.quote: Applications for acceptance as a doctoral candidate should be submitted before or immediately after starting your doctoral studies

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The acceptance application must include a signed supervision agreement, so supervisors are agreed before acceptance.
supervisor.quote: We need all required certificates and documents, the filled out supervision agreement, and the signatures of the docotral candidate and both supervisors

also.quote: During the study phase, each doctoral candidate is assigned at least two academic supervisors

funding.value: Candidates must organise their own funding; positions or scholarships exist only in some programmes, so funding is competitive, not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Doctoral candidates are responsible for organizing their own funding. | Doctoral programs can offer positions or scholarships, but this does not apply to all programs.

entry_route.value: The IBMI page does not state the entry degree.

notes: Covers the Computer Science doctoral subject. The IBMI page says PhDs in Bioinformatics and Medical Informatics belong to the Computer Science department, so those two subjects are covered here. The general Computer Science doctoral page was not found.
name: Computer Science (PhD)
